defects.justification: `gem 'sqlite3', '>= 1.7'` has no upper bound, so any future major release (with breaking API changes) is accepted; use a pessimistic `~>` constraint.
`gem 'puma', '>= 6.0'` has no upper bound, so a future Puma major version can be picked up silently; use `~> 6.0`.

The fixed-window counter (now / 60) lets a client send 60 requests at the end of one window and 60 more at the start of the next, i.e. 120 in about a second, which breaks the stated '60 requests per minute' rule. The README discloses the fixed window, so this is a fix comment rather than a blocker; use a sliding window or token bucket.
